The brand '7SABER' was established in 2019 by Otabek Umarov, head of the Triathlon Federation of Uzbekistan. The logo, designed to symbolize courage and willpower, gained popularity among athletes and fans. In 2020, a licensing agreement was formed with Urban Hayot LLC, leading to the official launch of the brand on June 25, 2021. The brand offers Saber Sneakers, priced at $86, available in various colors such as Serene, Tiffany, Dirty Blue, Sand, Light Green, Light Blue, Olive, Light Brown, Lilac, Khaki, Turquoise, Orange, Black, and Dark Blue, with sizes ranging from 41 to 48.
